[[File:Shielding_technique.png|thumb|right|200px|The shielding technique]]
The '''shielding technique''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] developed by a [[Unidentified Jedi healer|Jedi healer]] to combat the [[Dark Plague]] developed by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Terrak Morrhage]]. The healer used the technique to sever the afflicted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] from the influence of Morrhage one by one, although it ultimately cost the healer his life. The technique was later included in the archives of the [[Noetikon]] devices. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when the Dark Plague [[Dark Plague crisis|struck]] the Jedi Order once again, a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] used the technique once again to combat the threat.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
